ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels occupying the distal lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the medial region and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white geometric blobs on the lateral lobes; a central wedge of low-intensity black pigment extends from the base to the median notch with high-frequency mottling and speckling at the pigment transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow interior angle and deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe apex heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys with higher pixel-amplitude observed on the distal margins compared to the medial margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer distal edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concavity as the trajectory approaches the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct, high-contrast white annular/ring-shaped pixel clusters located within the dark pigment of the left medial lobe; high-relief white clusters (barnacles) on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal reddish-pink linear disruption on the left white lobe; multiple fine, unaligned dark vertical scratches on the right white lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular depigmented scars on the medial dark region and a visible reddish traumatic abrasion on the mid-section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, isolated low-intensity focal spot located in the lower-inner quadrant of the right white lobe.
